title: Architecture Contract
description: A single interface-level architectural contract. Human-owned source of truth; agents derive framework tests from it, never the reverse. Multi-modal authoring: at least one of rules, prose, or interfaces must be present.

id.description: Stable contract id referenced by arch:<id> evidence markers. Never reuse or renumber an id; retire instead.

maturity.description: locked = blocking (only a human-authored/reviewed commit may promote draft->locked); draft and provisional are warn-only on every non-pass verdict.

lockedBodySha256.description: SHA-256 of the reviewed executable test body. The runner refuses to execute a locked contract whose derived body hash does not match this value.

root.description: Source root the contract applies to.

targets.description: Source roots and globs the contract is evaluated against.

frameworks.description: Deterministic adapters that realize this contract. LLM semantic checks are advisory and configured under llm.

kind.description: Declarative rule kind, e.g. forbidden-dependency, layer-boundary, naming, sealed, no-cycles.

items.description: Extra framework-specific parameters (from, to, pattern, ...) are permitted alongside the required id and description.

rules.description: Declarative, machine-derivable rules the deterministic adapters translate into framework assertions.

prose.description: Human/agent prose describing the component and its constraints. Untrusted input to any LLM step; never executed.

path.description: Optional source path the stub corresponds to.

stub.description: Real interface stub as authored contract surface (untrusted input, never compiled from here).

interfaces.description: Real C#/TS interface stubs the human owns as the contract surface.

promoted.description: When true, raises the report severity of an LLM semantic finding; it never turns an advisory verdict into a build-breaking gate.
